normalized.subject: nervous tissue
normalized.relation_definition: The fundamental cell type that constitutes the structural and functional basis of a specified tissue; not merely any cell found within it.
normalized.canonical_fact: Neurons are the basis cells of nervous tissue.
normalized.prompt_en: What cell type is the basis of nervous tissue?
evidence_quotes: What cells are the basis of nervous tissue?
normalized.reason: Source directly states neurons are the basis cells of nervous tissue. No existing catalog relation precisely captures the specific 'basis cell type of a tissue' relationship; whole_to_part is too broad and entity_to_material refers to physical material composition. Proposing new relation tissue_to_basis_cell.
